rows.s_sql:
SET @prov_c='%s';
SET @id:= '%s';
SET @cat_id := '%s';
SET @send :=  IF((SELECT active FROM sys_report WHERE cat_id = @cat_id and id = @id )=1,0,2);
SET @b_year:=(SELECT variable FROM sys_variables WHERE vname = 'year_student');
SET @b_year_s:=(SELECT SUBSTR(GROUP_CONCAT(AcademicYear ORDER BY AcademicYear DESC),1,4) FROM school)-543;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS s_school2(
  id varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  hospcode varchar(5) NOT NULL,
  areacode varchar(8) NOT NULL,
  flag_sent varchar(1) NOT NULL,
  date_com varchar(14) NOT NULL,
  b_year varchar(4) NOT NULL,
	schoolid   varchar(10) NOT NULL,
  schoolname varchar(150) NOT NULL,
	jurisdictionid  varchar(2) NOT NULL,
  organizationtypecode varchar(6) NOT NULL,
  semester1 int(10) DEFAULT 0,
  semester2 int(10) DEFAULT 0,
PRIMARY KEY (id,hospcode,areacode,b_year,schoolid),
	KEY (hospcode),
	KEY (areacode),
	KEY (b_year),
  KEY (schoolid)
) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

DELETE FROM s_school2 WHERE id=@id AND b_year=(@b_year+543);
INSERT IGNORE INTO s_school2 (  id,hospcode,areacode,flag_sent,date_com,b_year,	schoolid,schoolname,organizationtypecode,jurisdictionid)
(
SELECT @id
,IFNULL(s.hospcode,'00000')
,IF(ROUND(s.SUBDISTRICTCODE)>0,s.SUBDISTRICTCODE,'')
,@send
,DATE_FORMAT(now(),'%Y%m%d%H%i') as d_com
,@b_year+543 as b_year
,IF(ROUND(s.SCHOOLID)>0,s.SCHOOLID,'')
,s.SCHOOLNAME
,IFNULL(o.OrganizationTypeID,'') 
,IFNULL(j.JurisdictionID,'')
FROM school s 	
	LEFT JOIN cjurisdiction j ON s.JURISDICTIONID=j.JurisdictionID 
	LEFT JOIN corganizationtype o ON s.ORGANIZATIONTYPECODE=o.OrganizationTypeID 
WHERE s.ACADEMICYEAR IN(@b_year_s+543) AND  s.SCHOOLSTATUSCODE NOT IN(2) 
AND SUBSTR(s.SUBDISTRICTCODE,1,2) in(@prov_c)
);
DROP TEMPORARY TABLE IF EXISTS tmps_student;
CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE  IF NOT EXISTS tmps_student(KEY (schoolid)) ENGINE=myisam IGNORE AS
SELECT SchoolID ,AcademicYear b_year
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(Semester in(1),CONCAT(SchoolID,'-',studentid,'-',PersonID),NULL))  semester1
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(Semester in(2),CONCAT(SchoolID,'-',studentid,'-',PersonID),NULL))  semester2
FROM  student WHERE AcademicYear in(@b_year+543) GROUP BY SchoolID;


UPDATE s_school2 s INNER JOIN tmps_student d ON s.schoolid=d.SchoolID 
SET s.semester1=d.semester1,s.semester2=d.semester2
WHERE s.b_year=d.b_year AND s.b_year in(@b_year+543);

DELETE FROM s_school2 WHERE  (semester1+semester2)=0;
